description: Land Title Settlement Department - Unagalawehera East, Hingurakgoda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120034 (23/0936)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land parcel numbers, extents, ownership information, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
